notes.title: 22 new cards!
notes.content:
[h2]Great news: A lot of new content![/h2]
Echo of Ayllu will soon have 22 new cards available in game. 
In patch 0.60 you can already see all those cards in the collection and they are available in Draft mode.

[u][b]Important: New cards won't appear in ships rewards UNTIL they appear in the breach, so 5 per week![/b][/u]

Deck Rotations will give you a way to try the new cards before they appear in the breach.

Here is a preview of the new cards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/1a05b5affda47ecc716808c5a8c1f0419d951caf.png[/img]


[h2]3 Free Ships[/h2]
Use this code to gain 10k credits and 3 free ships. These ships give you a x4 chance to find the cards of the week featured in the breach. 

[h3][b]BREACHEXPLORATION[/b][/h3]

[h2]0.60 Balance[/h2]
Freddy 6-3 -> 6-2
Sofie 3-3 -> 3-2
Coal 7-7 -> 8-8
Miko 6-2 -> 6-4
Mila 5-4 -> 6-2
jinhan 5-4 -> 5-3
meydan 5-4 -> 5-3
Rocky 4-5 -> 4-2  and gem cost changed from 2 to 1
Melt transfer ability changed to a talent
All Theft abilities are now limited to a maximum

Sharp 4-2 -> 5-2
Raw  4-3 -> 5-3
Frog powder ability changed from 4 to 5
Salty powder ability changed from 7 to 5
Bomcore has a new item ability

Marc 3-5 -> 3-3
Doc 2-4 -> 2-5
Nani 4-5 -> 5-4
Nano 4-5 -> 5-3
xeres 6-4 -> 7-3
watoo 5-5 -> 5-6
sibeal 4-6 -> 4-7, but her transfer limited to 7 PP
Wisp ability changed

[h2]Tournament[/h2]
In a few days a new DRAFT tournament will start, in draft mode all the new cards are available right away!

[h2]QoL[/h2]
Move history is now displayed in the corner. Also when hovering a card you can see the description of current status effects affecting a character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/be8040f2cfe86fb25f9e1176fc64a69d4d06e753.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/886956f379ec32d3d3ce3eab66922796fa177c1f.png[/img]

Waiting to see you in game!

notes.title: Rotations & Balance Patch 0.58
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
Xeres:  Action changed to Talent (3), but targets only 1 character and cannot target itself
Salty: Action changed to item (same effect)
Nikola :  overclock cost 5 -> 4
Rakam : Powder ability 5 -> 3
Rocal: Battlecry amount 2 -> 3
Xeus: 7-1   ->   7-3
Drill: 5-3  ->   5-4
Spark  7-5   ->   7-4
Octok   5-7   ->   5-6
Wisp 2-2 -> 2-4
Voois   1-3   ->   1-4
Rocky   4-4   ->  4-5

Also, If you missed the latest cards: 

[b]Mass II[/b]
An improved version of the original, Mass II is more expensive but comes with a secondary weapons, more ammunitions, and an extended warranty!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/89b7858fae963d319b048cba791cb51b802fc210.png[/img]

[b]Xerès[/b]
Xerès is one of Elysia's guardian defenders. This one holds a massive energy shield that can protect many things against most types of threats.

[b]Rotations[/b]
Every week, 2 or 3 rotation decks will be available in Ranked or Casual play. You can use those decks even if you do not own the cards in it, allowing you to try some new characters & strategies before spending on a new card.

notes.title: NEW CARDS, DIALOGUES AND CHALLENGING LEVELS
notes.content:
[h1][h3]NEW RELEASE:[/h3][/h1]

Lien moved to Elysia to study the strange and complex vegetation found on this planet. Many plants have been used by Elysian tribes for a long time, but very few have been studied properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/f6f5c952cc378150e4d1ba34f952d3f16ec4b210.jpg[/img]


Edmund is one of the leading Senators of the Promixa Galactic Government. If his peace policy is not unanimous among the assemblies, his diplomatic skills make him a key player within the interplanetary exchange caucus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/948c42a6b7c43febc02b20b3f6b145ab6d5f7fef.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW DIALOGUES:[/h1]

We have added new dialogues to help you understand the story of Echo of Ayllu better. Dialogues are played at the beginning and the end of some levels. Check them out in the game and let us know what you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/3de0c55a05c3a266ca84f533eb240c23e4de04de.png[/img]

[h1]NEW LEVELS[/h1]

Apart from the main campaign, which includes Terra, Elysia and Proxima, we also have very challenging levels called "Galactic Challenges". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/f7414fddd0d4bc9c919545e7f55fdba10d423a96.png[/img]

5 new levels has been added to the Ursarion zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/9a1dcebc4cc2d77319bfe0bae7e4a8c86bd454ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/096c33cbf068a0397f0a78d6653df5cb809d4873.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the new challenges levels. See you all on the battlefield!

The Echo of Ayllu team.

notes.title: NEW CARD, CARDBACK, MASTERY TRACK, BREACH & CHALLENGE!
notes.content:
[h2]NEW RELEASE:[/h2]
This week we have a lot of great news to share with you. First of all, a new card: KWI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/6c563fd3fba5f7c17d3454c700fe4f142697a428.png[/img]
Son of Kwomba, Kwi grew up in the Elysian jungles. He lost his mother following an incident with Proximate robots. Since then, he promised himself to avenge her. He has been training since a very young age and he is actually very skilled at archery for an 11 year old boy. 

[h2]NEW CARDBACK[/h2]
Our artists just created a new gorgeous Mecano cardback. What do you think about it?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/2e08e168668a40c684d4b445f71a2485957ca083.png[/img]

[h2]MASTERY TRACK:[/h2]
Playing multiple matches every day will move you along the Daily Progress track. The third match of the day will allow you to advance on the Mastery track with a lot of cool rewards such as rare cards, in-game cash, ships and even a new deck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/7ddcd18f24a97e85dd2fd7d79161aa2052f87e42.png[/img]

[h2]CARD BALANCE[/h2]
Check out the new card balance system:

kay 2-4 to 3-5
lama from 2-5 to 2-4
ranger 5-3 to 5-2
steam 7-2 to 7-3

faata 5-3 to 4-4
nani 4-4 to 5-4
nano 4-4 to 5-4
pico 5-4 to 6-3
flaq 6-4 to 6-2, from 2 Gem to 1 Gem
teraa from 7-2 to 7-1

rakam from 6-4 to 6-2, explosive Action changed to Talent, Pose ability from 10 powder to 5 powder
slicer from 7-2 to 7-3
mazelle from 3-2 to 3-4
tahna changed from 5-3 to 3-5, her pose ability changed from Draw 1 to Stealth

[h2]NEW BREACH[/h2]
Kwi, Kwomba, Lama, Melt and Meydan have a 2x chance to be won in this week's breach. Check them out in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/267b4a73d71e9db83ef9014939ed1d04e300958e.png[/img]

[h2]NEW CHALLENGE[/h2]
Complete these weekly challenges and win great rewards. Here are this week's challenges:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/fd97ce3ac97c20a85fd86918feeb82d5914554de.png[/img]

That's all for now. What do you think about all the new updates? Let us know in the comment section below. See you all on the battlefield!

- The Echo of Ayllu Team

notes.title: 1 ROBOT, 2 NEW SHIPS HAVE ARRIVED
notes.content:
[b]NEW RELEASE:[/b]
We have an exciting news to share: a cutting-edge robot and 2 marvellous ships have just come into play. 


Manufactured in a Proximate mass production facility, Sharp T5 has been programmed to track and stalk its target. Equipped with a satellite communication device, it can communicate remotely with other robots to recruit reinforcements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/00e181e37e50379bf4cd1bc2f071e649f4c6c500.png[/img]


As for the new ships, Flëëem is HUGE. Equipped with everything needed for long-distance travel, including a self-sufficient garden to produce food, a medical regenerative laboratory, and even a rain forest to feel at home.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/b3fcee44dfd60f8135aad1c1f9b02167a4d1c0fd.png[/img]


The other ship, Zaartès, or "Guardian of the Skies" in common tongue, is a ship originally designed to defend Elysia from space invasions, but today it is used in many ways as a personal vehicle or for diplomatic missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41082206/3bec983304d9fda075a28bd53ef5115889dd614c.png[/img]


NEW BREACH

Recent conflicts between Proxima and Elysia started worrying some high-ranked officials. Is war ahead? In any case it was time to prepare for any possible situation. Proxima's robot factories were asked to start producing at maximum capacity.




Due to this circumstance, Sharp T5, Raw T3, Bomcore, Cloud and Rocal have a 2x chance to be won in this week's breach. Check them out in game.


That's all for now. What do you think about the new card and ships? Let us know in the comment section below. See you all on the battlefield!


- The Echo of Ayllu Team

notes.title: BETA NEWS #12

Hello everyone!

A new card is coming out today, and not just any card, a heavyweight Champion : RAVAGER.

[b]NEW RELEASE[/b]
[i]Made from pieces of a domination artifact, the Ravager is undoubtedly one of the most dangerous mechanical beasts to be found on Proxima. This robot impresses not only with its size, but also with its outstanding attack capabilities.[/i]
[b]
Team: Offensive: Super-Attack:[/b] All allies gain Super-Attack. A Super Attack doubles the character's attack.

This week's new challenges have been launched. Up for grabs:
Swad's avatar, Hadaka, Tahna, Hadaka's avatar and 5000 credits!

[b]NEW TOURNAMENT[/b]
Blue Dominance
An aggressive tournament, max power! No gem limit, and only Domination!

[b]NEW RIFT[/b]
Raw Force
Proxima has entered the Elysian space. Their new weapon, "Ravager", marks a new page in history. If some Naqua seem surprised, the planet's armed forces have already deployed and are ready to receive them.

The following cards have a 2x chance of being won in this week's breach.
- Ravager
- Rocal
- Hadaka
- Nikitape
- Swad

An introduction cinematic of the adventure mode has been released! Find it here now :
[previewyoutube=paHWPg07xMs;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game !

notes.title: BETA #11
notes.content:
Dear players,

No new character today, but rather an information about the next ones.
Starting next week, 3 new champions will appear, and in a progressive way: Proxima, Elysia and finally Earth.

What we can tell you is that they will each in turn shake up a part of the meta!

[b]NEW TOURNAMENT[/b]
Draft Mania
Build your deck before each game, and face your opponents!
Only strategy counts!

[b]NEW RIFT[/b]
Rainbow
The new Rift looks a little different than usual. Different shades of color seem to emanate from this celestial rift in the form of steam, and muffled sounds echo in the ears of the spectators. Could it be a new war that is brewing?

[b]NEW CHALLENGES[/b]
This week to win: 
Cloud, his avatar, Saigo, Teraa and 5000 credits!

As for the rest, we are currently working on the introduction cinematic of the game, it promises to announce some heavy stuff.


That's it for today guys!
Thanks to all for your support, and good game to all!

- The EoA team

notes.title: BETA #10
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A new card is appearing today: Rocky! Man's best friend... or not! Either way, it will be up to you to train him well!

[b]NEW RELEASE[/b]
[i]Rocky is not a robot like the others. His inventor designed him to obey his owner in a versatile way. And he's also pretty cuddly... well... in general.[/i]
[b]
Pose: Decision: [/b]When Rocky enters the game, choose a skill to give him. Choose "Bite" to get Continuation, or Choose "Fetch!" to get Rush.
[b]Counter-Attack:[/b] If an adjacent character has been defeated, Rocky will immediately counterattack if he is stronger.

[b]NEW CHALLENGES[/b]
This week's new challenges are here. To be won:
Freddy's avatar, The Essential, Rocky, Kay and 5000 credits!

[b]NEW TOURNAMENT[/b]
Make the right choice
A Rush vs. Tempus tournament. Will you be the fastest or the most enduring?

[b]NEW BREACH[/b]
The time curve.
[i]Elysia seems to have gotten used to these phenomena by now. Some people are beginning to see how these anomalies work and are noticing that there are stories being played out inside them. This time, it seems that a race against time is taking place. Proxima is deploying more and more bases on earth and in space, all around the planet. Huge columns even seem to interconnect, linking these different bases to each other. Meanwhile, part of the Terran resistance is on its way to an area of its solar system where space-time anomalies have been detected.
[/i]
The following cards have a 2x chance of being won this week.
- Rocky
- Freddy
- Sin_31
- Rocal
- Doc

[b]NEW GIFTS[/b]
A RW Fighter and 2000 credits are to be collected in your stall!

[b]MISC[/b]
- Many bugs have been fixed.
- You can now change your deck during your tournaments. This change will reset your ELO score.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

- The Echo of Ayllu team

Hello everyone !

A new card is appearing today: Oyo, an old Naqua full of wisdom and patience. He brings with him a new mechanic in the game.

[b]NEW RELEASE[/b]
[i]Patience is a definite quality, but Oyo elevates it to the rank of Art. This Naqua, deeply respectful of everything around him, does not hesitate to force this same respect from his opponents.[/i]

[u]Action: Patience:[/u] You will be able to perform 2 actions during your next turn.

- Pico
- Nano

notes.title: BETA #8
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

A new card is appearing today: The Cowboy Ranger, and it brings with it a new mechanic in the game.

[b]NEW RELEASE[/b]
W. Ranger is a man of common sense ... in general ... but not when it comes to injustice. So if you decide to steal from your neighbor, don't do it in front of him.

Pose: Tie up: When he comes into play, Ranger can tie up an opposing character within his reach. A tied-up character can no longer attack, activate effects, or hold Energy Rocks. A tied up character is freed by moving.
Loot: Pillage: When Ranger steals an Energy Rock, he also steals 3 PP from the opponent's reserve. 

[b]NEW CHALLENGES[/b]
The new challenges are Cowboys oriented this week.
To be won: The character James and his avatar, the Hyperion ship, and 5,000 credits!
On your marks !

[b]NEW TOURNAMENT[/b]
Unleash An exclusively RUSH tournament with no gem limit. Let go of all your machines, and all your beasts, now is the real war for resources.

[b]NEW BREACH[/b]
The last great war pushed the Terrans to its most distant entrenchments. Today, no man, nor any law, can dictate their behavior. If looting has become an art, that of space travel is yet to be reviewed... And from afar, Elysia observes in her breach what appears to be an accident between two Earth ships.

These cards have a 2x more chance of being won in the Week's Breach.
- Ranger
- Miko
- Jhack
- Ibill
- James 
[b]
NEW GIFTS[/b]
Two Essentials are to be picked up in your stall!

[b]MISC[/b]
This week some updates have been made, especially with the arrival of new features:
- The history of your purchases and sales is available in the Cyberhall
- The shop interface has been improved
- You can now choose whether your Draft games are Ranked or Friendly. 
- The offices have been renamed to Stall.
- When a player connects to you in matchmaking, a sound will notify you.

Many thanks for your support and good play everyone! 
- The Echo of Ayllu team

notes.title: BÊTA NEWS #6
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
A new card is appearing today, and it is a little Naqua, quite special.

NEWCOMER

Even if Pico has regeneration capacities that are a little faster than average, he is nonetheless as playful as his fellows. Which sometimes leads him into surprising situations.

Regeneration : If defeated, Pico will return to your hand.
Surge : Whenever Pico moves, he gains +3 PP.

NEW CHALLENGES
The new challenges of the week can earn you Nani's avatar, Naga and Nani cards, an Elysia card back and 5,000 credits! On your marks !

NEW TOURNAMENT
A tournament in Standard games, decks limited to 12 gems. Bring out the light artillery!

NEW BRECHE
Beyond life
If life exists elsewhere, we are there. The latest stellar crack appears to reveal highlights of some Naquas celebs. Clones? Illusions? Deception? Anomalies? Theories are rife on Elysia.

These cards have 2x more chances to be intercepted:
- PICO
- JAAOA
- NAGA
- NANO
- NANI

MISC
Some maps have been slightly modified:
- Luna goes from 3-3 to 4-2. Luna now adds her own attack to adjacent robots. (Its effect therefore no longer multiplies the attack of the adjacent robot by Luna's PP).
- Mila goes from 4-4 to 5-4.
- Meydan goes from 5-3 to 5-5
- Wendy goes from 3-5 to 3-6
- Lama and Marc: Talent Transfer ability cost changed from 1 to 2.
- The term (in English only) 'Robery' becomes Pillage.
- The term (in English only) 'Swift' becomes Surge.
- If you haven't bought anything in-game, sales are no longer limited to 3 overall, but to 3 per category in the lobby (so you can now sell 3 characters, 3 ships and 3 materials)
- The bug of the Steam achievement "Victory against Redstalk 10" has been fixed.
- Player level crossings are now more progressive.


Many thanks for your support and good play everyone!

- The Echo of Ayllu team

notes.title: BETA NEWS #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
A new card is appearing today, and it is a little spy robot, quite special, since it brings a new mechanic to the game.

NEW CARD
OLI.
If the need to peek at your opponent's army arises, recruit Oli. Equipped with infrared cameras, discreet and fast, it will give you an obvious strategic advantage.

Scout: As long as Oli is in play, you can see the opponent's hand.
Talent: Flee: Oli can escape the game board. PP are returned to the reserve. Does not count as a Kill.

NEW CHALLENGES

notes.title: OPEN BETA
notes.content:
Welcome back among us pioneers! And welcome to the newcomers too, since the open beta allows free access to the game today!

With the launch of this one, a few new features are emerging:
- You can now give RedStalk one of your decks.
- The overall interface has been improved for a clearer rendering.
- A rewards panel at the end of tournaments has been added.
- The history of cards won with ships is now displayed in your profile.
- Some cards have new sound effects!
- A panel for adventure mode has been added.
- Server stability has been optimized
- The problem of emails not received is resolved.
- Rocal's stats are now 6/6 instead of 6/5.
- The Security effect now secures your character from all negative enemy effects.
- The black screen bug in adventure mode has been fixed.
- A large number of errors in the texts have been corrected (thanks to Lebrun!).

This is also an opportunity for us to make an announcement. Every Friday, a new card will appear, and some events may bring more. Anyway, remember that every week there will be at least one new release! 

See you soon guys;) 

- Discovery

notes.title: BETA NEWS #3
notes.content:
End of the closed beta, transition, early access, we give you all the dates! But before that, some improvements made recently for this BETA 0.12.

- The challenges now have a countdown, which allows you to be informed of the arrival of the next ones.
- On the last turn of the TEMPUS FUGIS artifact, a message "LAST TURN!" appears.
- On your last kill to do with the DOMINATION artifact, a message "LAST KO!" appears.
- A button "Exit" has been added to the menu, at the top right.
- A window mode has been added.
- A "Neutral" filter has been added for materials and ships in Cyberhall.
- Various corrections of texts and translations.
- Better server stability.
- Improved main menu presentation.
- Two new avatars appeared during registration: Salt and Kay!

BETA INFO
The closed beta ends October 4. We will therefore take a transition period of a few days in order to better prepare for the opening of early access on Steam scheduled for October 15. New cards will appear!

notes.title: BETA NEWS #2
notes.content:
Hi all! The news seems to be linked in recent days, and for good reason! Many of you gave us your feedback, and we took them into account. So the bugs have been fixed and improvements have been made. With a bonus gift! And find information about the opening of the beta at the end of the post. 


[b]BETA 0.11[/b]

- The opponent 's Maximum Attack is now visible by clicking on its reserve. This attack takes into account the PP that the opponent will receive in the next turn!

- The ship system has been improved. See details below.

- Ship stats have been adjusted for this new format.
- The creation of foils only requires 5 copies of the card instead of 10 previously.

- Ultra wide screens are now supported in 16: 9 and 16:10.

- Some adventure mode levels have been adjusted.

- The challenges interface has been improved, and is now clearer to understand.

- Meydän goes to 5/3 instead of 4/3 previously.

- Flaq goes from 6/4 instead of 5/4 previously.

- A reconnection message is displayed after 5 seconds of Internet disconnection.

- Numerous small bugs fixed, in particular on certain card reactions. 


[b]SHIPS[/b]

Now the ships give cards to each game. As much in your victories as in the defeats. Some differences that said:  - The Radar indicates the rate of chances of obtaining Rare or Mythic cards in case of victory. In case of defeat, the rate is 5%. - Fuel is used to intercept new characters. Each game gives you 1 new character and therefore burns you 1 point of fuel. - Resistance is the number of defeats the ship can take.

[b]NEW BREACH[/b]

A new breach has appeared! And Elysia is in the spotlight! To celebrate, 5,000 credits are offered to you (meeting in the offices) as well as the great Toba-I to intercept as many Elysians as possible! Place your Toba-I in the breach to intercept Elysians!   


[b]OPENING OF THE BETA[/b]

On October 21, an exceptional event will take place on Steam: The Digital Tabletop Fest, and we have the honor to tell you that Echo of Ayllu will participate! Thus, from October 15 the beta will open in public! 

Good game everyone!

notes.title: BETA NEWS #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The beta was launched a few days ago and already the first patch has arrived. Many corrections have been made:
[b]
BETA 0.10[/b]

- It is now possible to exit adventure mode using the ESCAPE key on the keyboard.

- The back menu arrow of adventure mode has changed its appearance.

- You can now access audio / visual options from games directly.

- To access tournaments, it is now enough to have 3 victories in multiplayer, instead of 5 previously.

- The language button is now accessible from the registration menu.

- The difficulty of some adventure mode levels have been changed.

- And finally a new feature: a small icon now appears on the PLAY button if a player is waiting in matchmaking.

Good game everyone !
